commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; python3 - <<'PY'
import time,serial
port='/dev/cu.usbserial-130'
with serial.Serial(port,115200,timeout=0.25,write_timeout=2) as ser:
    time.sleep(2.0)
    ser.reset_input_buffer()
    for cmd in ('M119','M114'):
        ser.write((cmd+'\n').encode()); ser.flush(); print('TX',cmd,flush=True)
        deadline=time.monotonic()+5
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            raw=ser.readline()
            if not raw: continue
            text=raw.decode('utf-8',errors='replace').strip()
            if text: print('RX',text,flush=True)
            low=text.lower()
            if low=='ok' or low.startswith('ok '): break
print('RESULT:ENDSTOP_CHECK_DONE')
PY
